   566	private lemma row_perturbation {n : ℕ} (T : Mat n) (b z : Vec n)
   567	    {g : ℝ} (hg : 0 ≤ g)
   568	    (hres : ∀ i, |T.mulVec z i - b i| ≤ g * (∑ k, |T i k * z k|)) :
   569	    ∃ E : Mat n, (T + E).mulVec z = b ∧ ∀ i k, |E i k| ≤ g * |T i k| := by
   570	  let S : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => ∑ k, |T i k * z k|
   571	  let r : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => T.mulVec z i - b i
   572	  have hS : ∀ i, 0 ≤ S i := fun i => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => abs_nonneg _)
   573	  have hr0 : ∀ i, S i = 0 → r i = 0 := by
   574	    intro i hi
   575	    apply abs_eq_zero.mp
   576	    apply le_antisymm _ (abs_nonneg _)
   577	    have hh : |r i| ≤ g * S i := hres i
   578	    simpa only [hi, mul_zero] using hh
   579	  have hratio : ∀ i, |r i / S i| ≤ g := by
   580	    intro i
   581	    by_cases hi : S i = 0
   582	    · simp [hi, hg]
   583	    · rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (hS i)]
   584	      exact (div_le_iff₀ (lt_of_le_of_ne (hS i) (Ne.symm hi))).2 (hres i)
   585	  let sg : Fin n → ℝ := fun k => if 0 ≤ z k then 1 else -1
   586	  have hsg : ∀ k, sg k * z k = |z k| := by
   587	    intro k
   588	    dsimp [sg]
   589	    split_ifs with hk
   590	    · simp [abs_of_nonneg hk]
   591	    · simp [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hk)]
   592	  have habssg : ∀ k, |sg k| = 1 := by intro k; dsimp [sg]; split_ifs <;> norm_num
   593	  let E : Mat n := fun i k => -(r i / S i) * |T i k| * sg k
   594	  refine ⟨E, ?_, ?_⟩
   595	  · ext i
   596	    rw [Matrix.add_mulVec, Pi.add_apply]
   597	    have he : E.mulVec z i = -r i := by

   599	      calc

   601	          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   602	          intro k _
   603	          dsimp [E]
   604	          rw [mul_assoc, mul_assoc, hsg, abs_mul]
   605	        _ = -(r i / S i) * S i := by rw [← Finset.mul_sum]

   607	          by_cases hi : S i = 0
   608	          · simp [hi, hr0 i hi]
   609	          · field_simp
   610	    rw [he]
   611	    dsimp [r]
   612	    ring
   613	  · intro i k
   614	    change |-(r i / S i) * |T i k| * sg k| ≤ _
   615	    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_abs, habssg, mul_one]
   616	    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hratio i) (abs_nonneg _)

   638	/-- Full selected Cholesky Solve theorem. The run certificates include absence
   639	 of overflow/underflow at every used primitive and standard sqrt rounding.
   640	 Both bounds are componentwise; no symmetry of ΔA is asserted. Dimension zero
   641	 and exact arithmetic u=0 are included. No paper backward-error lemma is assumed. -/
   642	theorem cholesky_solve
   643	    {n : ℕ} (u : ℝ) (rnd : ℝ → ℝ) (A : Mat n) (b : Vec n)
   644	    (R : Mat n) (y x : Vec n)
   645	    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hsmall : ((n : ℝ) + 1) * u < 1)
   646	    (hsymm : A.transpose = A) (hpos : A.PosDef)
   647	    (hrun : SolveRun u rnd A b R y x) :
   648	    ∃ ΔA : Mat n,
   649	      (A + ΔA).mulVec x = b ∧
   650	      (∀ i j, |ΔA i j| ≤
   651	        (gamma u (n + 1) + 2 * gamma u n + (gamma u n) ^ 2) *
   652	          (absMatrix R.transpose * absMatrix R) i j) ∧
   653	      (∀ i j,
   654	        (gamma u (n + 1) + 2 * gamma u n + (gamma u n) ^ 2) *
   655	            (absMatrix R.transpose * absMatrix R) i j ≤
   656	        (3 * gamma u (n + 1) + (gamma u n) ^ 2) *
   657	          (absMatrix R.transpose * absMatrix R) i j) := by
   658	  have hsmall' : ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * u < 1 := by simpa using hsmall
   659	  have hn : (n : ℝ) * u < 1 := small_of_le hu (by omega) hsmall'
   660	  have hgn : 0 ≤ gamma u n := gamma_nonneg hu hn
   661	  obtain ⟨L, hLsolve, hL⟩ := row_perturbation R.transpose b y hgn
   662	    (forward_residual hu hn hrun.forward)
